scope: Agent-authored per-file conclusions after procedural prose, tool-contract and failure-case review. Contract details describe the frozen source, not verified current service behavior. Domain code/schemas are separately excluded; license does not substitute for conceptual review.

automation_residuals.ahrefs: Column selection affects cost and result scope; scope modes, regional/date filters, batch limits and cursor contract must be explicit. SEO metric recipes add no separate agent method.
automation_residuals.apify: Inspect actor-specific input schema; use sync only within its wait budget, otherwise retain async run identity; paginate datasets and cap retrieval size. Actor selection is domain data.
automation_residuals.apollo: Permission failures are deterministic; enrichment may succeed with missing individual records. Discover contacts before creating to avoid duplicates, and verify domains before relying on them.
automation_residuals.ashby: Resolve candidate before application, inspect job-state prerequisites, use scoped opaque IDs and cursor/sync-token contracts. Recruiting entity recipes are not distinct prompt patterns.
automation_residuals.attio: Workspace custom attributes need discovery; nested attribute and path-reference filters differ. Eventually consistent search cannot prove immediate read-after-write truth; use the documented stronger read operation.
automation_residuals.braintree: Title/toolkit provider differs from STRIPE_* operations in the body. Search syntax, cursor IDs, currency units and mutually dependent subscription fields are domain contracts; do not treat this file as verified Braintree instructions.
automation_residuals.capsule-crm: Filter property paths differ from creation payload shape; removing nested items requires the real child ID. Discover schema and identities rather than translating UI names directly.
automation_residuals.clockify: Resolve workspace and user IDs first; tags belong to a workspace; running timer is a precondition for a new timer. Explicit timezone and pagination prevent scope/window errors.
automation_residuals.cloudinary: Preset fields must agree with upload mode; exact asset identity is a tuple, not a guessed string. Inspect quota and processing/invalidation state; unsupported field combinations fail deterministically.
automation_residuals.coinbase: IDs act as continuation cursors; aggregate pages before portfolio conclusions. Periodic comparisons need retained previous identities; wallet recipes add no new mechanism.
automation_residuals.composio: Generic discovery/connect/execute scaffold; normalization differs because the app name collides with the platform brand. No independent method beyond the base family.
automation_residuals.contentful: Fetch current version immediately before update and reconcile conflicts. Read permission does not imply write scope; list pagination and identifier validation remain endpoint-specific.
automation_residuals.customerio: Exactly one audience representation is accepted; segment IDs must be discovered. Broadcast limits, timestamp units and continuation names are service contracts, not new prompt methods.
automation_residuals.docker-hub: Organization discovery precedes dependent operations; auth method and paid features are explicit prerequisites; webhook creation includes a second association step. Domain tool recipes are consolidated.
automation_residuals.dynamics365: Related entities use distinct reference syntax and opaque IDs. Creation with optional schema fields can still create useless empty records; business validity is stronger than syntactic acceptance.
automation_residuals.elevenlabs: Select accessible compatible models/voices from metadata, inspect quota before bulk generation and save temporary audio output promptly. A large preview is not proof the complete voice list was inspected.
automation_residuals.eventbrite: Organization discovery feeds event IDs, then attendee queries. Continuation tokens and changed-since windows must be honored; display categories are not parameter IDs.
automation_residuals.excel: Read existing headers before aligning writes; upsert by a stable key; distinguish append from replace and strict from silent truncation; read back results. Google Sheets fallback is explicit, not an assumed universal capability.
automation_residuals.facebook: Cache page identities in the selected run; wait for video processing; convert schedule time explicitly. Sending and marking seen have visible effects and require the applicable authorization.
automation_residuals.firecrawl: Freeze extraction contract, pilot small inputs, inspect nested per-page errors and preserve async job IDs. Bound crawl scope/cost and recover based on rate/error class.
automation_residuals.freshbooks: Discover business ID before project operations, scope changes by time and interpret empty result as valid when documented. Duration units need explicit conversion for reporting.
automation_residuals.gong: Fetch workspace/call identity and required scope, paginate calls, use exclusive end-time semantics correctly and retain expiring media when authorized. Transcript/content recipes are domain data.
automation_residuals.google-admin: Account lifecycle operations differ in reversibility; inspect actual user before changes and distinguish reads from privileged writes. Membership role update is a remove/re-add workflow in this source.
automation_residuals.google-maps: Geocode/search outputs feed route/detail inputs; batch matrix has a different result shape. Cross-field travel-mode constraints and API-key-only operations require actual schema/auth discovery.
automation_residuals.google-search-console: Property identity syntax, locale/region, fixed windows, data lag and pagination constrain conclusions. Submitted sitemap must be accessible, but submission alone does not prove indexing.
automation_residuals.googleads: Body uses Analytics operations and account/property hierarchy. Discover metadata and validate metric/dimension compatibility before reporting; do not present as a direct Ads mutation recipe.
automation_residuals.googlebigquery: Body explicitly routes through Metabase; its database/table/field IDs are distinct from BigQuery names. Discover source metadata, parameterize values and inspect nested response shape.
automation_residuals.googledocs: Search/inspect precedes edit; whole-document replacement, append and targeted replacement have different effects. Parameter labels differ even when document/file identity is equal.
automation_residuals.googlemeet: Resolve attendee names, current time/timezone and availability before scheduling. Calendar and Meet are distinct services; personal-account fallback must be reported explicitly.
automation_residuals.googlephotos: Resolve opaque album/media IDs; uploaded media may not be visible immediately. API-created/owned album restrictions and deprecation are frozen observations, not current API promises.
automation_residuals.googleslides: Copy a template then apply content, or create a new presentation; these operations differ from append. Inspect actual object IDs before targeted updates and thumbnails.
automation_residuals.googletasks: Resolve list and task IDs together, do not substitute names/default aliases. Clear-completed is destructive; bulk task creation and pagination are separate contracts.
automation_residuals.gorgias: Explicit time filters, separate custom-field reads, offset checkpoints and auth/error handling are necessary for honest full exports. Partial data must not be labeled complete.
automation_residuals.groqcloud: Model/voice IDs and features are runtime metadata; nested list shape must be inspected. Do not hardcode remembered capability names as proof of accessibility.
automation_residuals.gumroad: Check existing webhooks before subscribing; product ID may be needed for license validation. Pagination and historical date format are service-specific parameters.
automation_residuals.harvest: Validate task/project pairing, not merely global task existence; tracking mode changes which fields apply. Endpoint page sizes differ; one default cannot be copied across operations.
automation_residuals.heygen: Inspect all template variables before generation, preserve async identity, wait for complete status and handle expiring output URLs. Template names do not imply variable schemas.
automation_residuals.hunter: Empty results differ from authentication failure; counts are estimates, not retrievable totals. Verification uncertainty needs separate treatment; quota and pagination bound completeness.
automation_residuals.instantly: Sending accounts must be discovered; sequence structure and schedule fields must be complete. Permission and validation errors need repair rather than blind retry; source timezone alternatives are not assumed equivalent.
automation_residuals.jotform: Inspect authenticated account, folders/labels and plan-dependent fields before workflow selection. Date format, owner scope and offset pagination are domain contract differences.
automation_residuals.kommo: Pipeline and status identity form a pair; custom fields need runtime discovery. Date units, ID types and human/robot attribution are explicit parameters, not generic prompt patterns.
automation_residuals.launch-darkly: Resolve project/environment keys before triggers; creation produces a URL, deletion is irreversible and gated features require proper access. Preserve side-effect distinctions.
automation_residuals.lemlist: Inspect wrapped responses, verify campaign before writes, checkpoint bounded imports and resolve real lead ID before variable updates. Add-variable is not upsert; cross-campaign dedup is conditional.
automation_residuals.lemon-squeezy: Store identity scopes downstream reads; pagination and filter parameter names differ from ordinary JSON labels. One-time orders and subscription invoices are different data sources.
automation_residuals.lever: Read before full-replacement requisition update; required fields must survive a one-field edit. Expansion types and timestamp formats differ by operation, and reads do not grant write scope.
automation_residuals.mailerlite: Subscriber cursor and campaign page pagination differ; first-page engagement is a sampling artifact. Inspect nested response shape and aggregate complete, correctly scoped records.
automation_residuals.microsoft-clarity: Short rolling export windows require scheduled snapshots for long history; high-cardinality dimensions increase output size. Single-tool availability bounds what the integration can do.
automation_residuals.mistral-ai: File references require staging and exact contract; some schemas need reference expansion. RAG ingestion is async; uploaded does not mean query-ready.
automation_residuals.neon: Resolve organization/project/branch/database/role in order; validate role/database pairing. Returned connection URI embeds secrets and must not be logged or publicly shown.
automation_residuals.netsuite: Inspect account record metadata, resolve references, reuse stable external IDs and verify created totals. Schema requiredness and business-required fields may differ; unsupported filters need a supported alternative.
automation_residuals.new-relic: Channel creation is not sufficient until linked to a policy; config schema depends on channel type. Identity types differ by endpoint and names may need uniqueness checks.
automation_residuals.omnisend: Contact upsert uses email identity; update requires resolved internal ID. Async batch method constraints and event dependencies must match the discovered operation.
automation_residuals.openai: Model availability and parameter capabilities should be discovered; structured-output schemas have explicit contracts. Frozen model limits/deprecation statements are not accepted as current product facts.
automation_residuals.pandadoc: Recipient roles and ordering must be internally consistent; file and URL alternatives are exclusive. Upsert-by-email does not rename email identity, and folder/document IDs differ.
automation_residuals.phantombuster: Inspect organization resource scope and quota; containers depend on agent ID. Script-list metadata is not source content; absence of code must remain explicit.
automation_residuals.prismic: Acquire content refs before querying; pagination strategy changes at deep pages; locale and integration refs are distinct scope dimensions. Queries are source contracts, not reusable per-domain patterns.
automation_residuals.productboard: Hierarchy determines which IDs support operations; relative/absolute windows and tag filter modes are exclusive. Feedback needs attribution and pagination varies by endpoint.
automation_residuals.quickbooks: Resolve customer/item/account references, read fresh sync token before edit and verify created invoice. Currency/identity/scope business rules are not inferred from labels.
automation_residuals.ramp: Explicit state filters avoid silently omitting declined transactions; timestamp/currency units and parameter precedence constrain reporting. Follow ID continuation before claiming all transactions.
automation_residuals.replicate: Inspect the selected model's schema and version; sync waits are bounded while longer jobs need async handling. Binary input encoding, stale file references and public/deployment routes are different contracts.
automation_residuals.ring-central: Explicit capability absence is retained; unrelated provider results are alternatives, never RingCentral evidence. Future support must be discovered rather than invented.
automation_residuals.semrush: Parse actual CSV-like response before analysis; a documented no-data string is not transport failure. Batch-size fallback, regional database, monthly dates and column codes are domain constraints.
automation_residuals.share-point: Resolve site hierarchy; delta queries expose incremental changes. Organizational-account requirements, relative paths and per-endpoint paging/filter syntax must be respected.
automation_residuals.shortcut: Creation requires a valid mutually exclusive destination choice; integer story IDs differ from member UUIDs. Explicit story type avoids incorrect defaults and bulk size remains bounded.
automation_residuals.snowflake: Discover database/schema/table hierarchy; compute requires an appropriate warehouse while metadata reads may not. User values belong in bindings, not executable SQL concatenation.
automation_residuals.spotify: Select account/device and verify ownership/premium prerequisites before effects. Context URI and track URIs are exclusive; collaborative/public flags must agree.
automation_residuals.survey-monkey: Creation produces an empty survey rather than a distribution link or responses; preserve survey ID and inspect questions to decode results. Completed response filtering and pagination bound statistics.
automation_residuals.toggl: Resolve workspace, use actual tag names rather than borrowed IDs and include documented required attribution field. Time units/modes and premium feature gates are explicit contracts.
automation_residuals.uploadcare: Uploaded and permanently retained are different states; persistence and temporary links need explicit lifecycle handling. Toolkit manages existing uploads and cannot invent an absent upload tool.
automation_residuals.wave-accounting: Placeholder explicitly reports no native capability and lists named alternatives. It does not provide executable Wave tool contracts; do not turn generic scaffold into proof of support.
automation_residuals.webex: Target routes and some filters are mutually exclusive; title is still required for certain updates. Webhook creation depends on read scope and endpoint health; frozen message limits need current verification.
automation_residuals.workday: Resolve worker and eligible absence type before submission. Creating a request starts approval, not completion; report pending process status rather than approval success.
automation_residuals.xero: Explicit tenant selection prevents first-account routing; inspect chart/account identity and paginate reads. Unsupported filter fallback must preserve desired scope.
automation_residuals.zoho-books: Organization scope precedes contact/invoice identity; full bill update must retain required fields. Bulk export has its own limit and undocumented options are not durable prompt assumptions.
automation_residuals.zoho-desk: Capability absence and unrelated-provider discovery are reported plainly; future real slugs/schemas are required. No current helpdesk support guarantee is extracted.

non_automation_skills.artifacts-builder: Complexity trigger separates simple and multi-component artifacts; helper initialization and single-file bundling centralize deterministic work. Optional testing is a source preference, not proof quality checks are unnecessary.
non_automation_skills.brand-guidelines: Explicit palette/font/fallback specification supplies reusable domain data. Brand-specific values are not a separate general method.
non_automation_skills.canvas-design: Philosophy precedes canvas; minimal text, bounded layout and refinement are concrete checks. Repeated craftsmanship rhetoric and invented user complaint are not extracted as guarantees.
non_automation_skills.changelog-generator: Transform technical commits into user-facing changes and filter irrelevant noise; preserve supported facts. Illustrative speedups in sample release notes are not measured evidence.
non_automation_skills.competitive-ads-extractor: Evidence collection, thematic comparison and hypothesis testing are transferable; ad visibility does not establish performance or successful messaging. Domain campaign advice is not a proven efficacy claim.
non_automation_skills.connect-apps: Search/connect/execute and explicit auth prerequisites provide a task mechanism. Integration counts and setup timing are promotional snapshot claims, not verified results.
non_automation_skills.connect: Task-specific tool routing, auth and action results distinguish actual execution from a draft. External actions still follow explicit task authorization.
non_automation_skills.content-research-writer: Outline/research/section feedback/voice preservation/citation review are operational; fabricated-looking sample metrics/author identities are examples, never research facts.
non_automation_skills.developer-growth-analysis: Bounded timestamped history grounds prioritized recommendations, but user-message history is not automatically a complete agent execution trace. Sharing private analysis is a separate authorized effect.
non_automation_skills.docx: Branch by reading/creation/edit provenance, use small verified batches and preserve untouched text. Redlining baseline equivalence and reference-specific loading are reviewed conceptually without copying implementation.
non_automation_skills.pdf: Inspect fillable capability, then validate field IDs or rendered input geometry. Use one chosen tool per task, not all libraries indiscriminately; domain library examples are not new patterns.
non_automation_skills.pptx: Inspect template structure, preserve paragraph properties and inventory real shapes; render and verify content after conversion. Serialization validity and visual validity are different checks.
non_automation_skills.xlsx: Externalize assumptions, use formulas, recalculate and inspect resulting errors; preserve established template conventions. Cached values and formula text are different artifacts.
non_automation_skills.domain-name-brainstormer: Generate candidates then verify availability; speculative pricing/TLD reputation and registration advice require current evidence before use. Domain naming heuristics add no separate agent mechanism.
non_automation_skills.file-organizer: Inspect scope, show an actionable plan, confirm destructive work, record undo mapping and preserve metadata. File age is a grouping hint, not deletion authorization.
non_automation_skills.image-enhancer: Use-case-specific output and original preservation are transferable; illustrative before/after dimensions do not demonstrate successful image enhancement.
non_automation_skills.internal-comms: Named reference routing binds task, audience, format and evidence; broad popularity signals do not replace authoritative sources.
non_automation_skills.invoice-organizer: Extract/normalize fields, retain originals and route ambiguity for review. File modification date is a fallback hint, not proof of invoice date; tax/audit claims are not generalized.
non_automation_skills.langsmith-fetch: Trace-specific ordered tool evidence enables diagnosis; no-traces has multiple causes. Exporting trace metadata should not expose secrets; real latency/token values differ from sample outputs.
non_automation_skills.lead-research-assistant: Explicit customer criteria and fit score rationale connect evidence to prioritization. Contact recommendations must remain qualified, not invented decision-maker facts.
non_automation_skills.mcp-builder: Agent-centered task interface, bounded responses, corrective errors, SDK-specific references and stable read-only evaluations form reusable methods; protocol annotations are not authorization guarantees.
non_automation_skills.meeting-insights-analyzer: Timestamped speaker observations support feedback and comparison; sentiment/behavior interpretation stays an inference. Unavailable timing data cannot support invented speaking percentages.
non_automation_skills.raffle-winner-picker: Eligibility/dedup/output audit ideas are inspectable; cryptographic, unbiased and seed-verification promises lack a concrete algorithm/implementation and are rejected as technical guarantees.
non_automation_skills.skill-creator: Concrete trigger examples define scope; deterministic scripts, references and assets load differently; package only after minimal metadata checks. Prose overstates the validator's actual coverage.
non_automation_skills.skill-share: Creation/validation/package/notification combines existing mechanisms; its declared LICENSE file is missing. Slack notification is an external effect, not an implied part of every creation request.
non_automation_skills.slack-gif-creator: Composable motion primitives plus measured size/dimension feedback support constraint-driven iteration; math/templates are domain implementation. Silent validator mode checks only size, not every constraint.
non_automation_skills.tailored-resume-generator: Map requirements to substantiated experience, prioritize and preserve truth; illustrative quantified achievements must not be invented for a real applicant.
non_automation_skills.template-skill: Empty scaffold with description placeholder; no operational transferable method is present.
non_automation_skills.theme-factory: Select/read/apply a named specification, or create/review a fallback. Ten palette files are domain presets with the same reusable specification shape.
non_automation_skills.twitter-algorithm-optimizer: Embeds named recommendation concepts and supplies same-task rewrites; expected engagement/performance remains hypothesis, not measured proof. Rewriting must preserve real facts rather than add fictional wins.
non_automation_skills.video-downloader: Expose helper options, inspect metadata then execute matching format/output route. Automatic package installation and default directories are task-dependent behavior, not universal policy.
non_automation_skills.webapp-testing: Observe rendered state before actions, use helper contract to manage dependencies, and inspect real logs/screenshots. Network idle and TCP listening are limited readiness signals.
